title: Webhooks can target the cloud metadata address; blueprint and review webhooks skip the URL check
zohoSource: TAVI's own workflow rule check (expected behaviour)

panels.caption: Blueprint / review save internal URLs; the egress policy lets 169.254.169.254 through
Expected: the check TAVI already applies to workflow rules, everywhere
text: TAVI workflow rules already refuse these URLs: "Webhook Url must be a public http(s) endpoint; loopback, private, link-local, and internal addresses are not allowed".
The outbound egress policy already cancels host names that resolve to 127.0.0.1 ("custom-actions-egress-blocked").
Expected: the same save-time check for blueprint After / SLA webhooks and the review process webhookUrl, and the egress policy also blocking link-local 169.254.0.0/16 (cloud metadata).
panels.flag: EXPECTED — TAVI's own rule (OWASP SSRF guidance)

notes: Run-time test approved by the user (25 Oct). No response body came back; only the status was recorded.
Blueprint webhooks are not sent at all today (WH-10), so their missing save check becomes live once that is fixed.
